c1.note: The SEC exhibit and the company press release both confirm the WBD acquisition closed on Oct 6, 2026. The $110B figure comes from press coverage.

c5.note: Variety reports a Tuesday (Oct 6) memo acknowledging layoffs, saying integration brings change including difficult decisions. No headcount is given.

c10.note: The shareholder letter is signed David Ellison, Chairman & CEO, and Ynon Kreiz, Co-CEO.

c11.note: Deadline says the $6B cost synergies promised to Wall Street 'will include layoffs'.

c12.note: The $6B+ target within three years is supported by the press release, and Deadline says the synergies include layoffs. The 'annualized' wording matches run-rate.

c16.note: Shareholder letter states more than 20 workstreams underway to evaluate and rightsize organization and cost structure.

c17.note: CEO memo acknowledged layoffs coming; no total headcount disclosed per Variety and other coverage.

c45.note: Deadline says the 2,000 total reduction amounts to 10% of Paramount's workforce; both variants are consistent with this (the 2025 round).

c47.note: CNN via ABC7 reports Bakish announced the layoffs in a memo on Feb 13, 2024. This is old history.

c48.note: CNN sources put the cuts at around 800 employees, roughly 3%. Deadline also reports over 800 affected.

c50.note: The company's own SEC earnings exhibit says the WBD acquisition completed on October 6, 2026. Variety agrees, so the close date is confirmed and 'neither is confirmed' is wrong.

c51.note: The Oct 2026 Day One memo and the Nov 2026 coverage describe workforce decisions and cuts across the combined Skydance, Paramount and WBD company, not only legacy Paramount.

c46.note: The AP/CBS story dated Oct 29, 2025 quotes Ellison's memo: 'never made lightly'. It also reports that workforce cuts are 'part of that process'. The memo is from October 2025, so the fact is dated and not current.
